title: Sales and campaign health
what_to_watch: Sales performance and the connected acquisition and conversion signals that explain material movement.
why_watch: Determine whether a material sales movement needs coordinated leadership, marketing, and sales action.
watch_for: A material decline in total sales or an important channel.
A time-linked acquisition or conversion change that explains the movement.
Conflicting evidence, missing data, or a data-quality issue.
questions: Which channel or customer journey explains the movement?
What changed recently that is supported by independent evidence?
Who should be involved if the evidence supports a coordinated response?
decision_guidance: Ignore ordinary movement. Investigate material movement when the cause is not yet supported. Notify only when the evidence bundle supports a significant business impact and a credible explanation; do not treat one correlated signal as proof of causation.
follow_up_guidance: Inspect authorized channel, acquisition, funnel, campaign, ownership, deployment, and data-quality sources. Preserve the comparison window and time relationship for each finding, then re-evaluate this same card before delivery.
